about: SDK 4.0: when the SDK asks a learner to share (SHARE_ASK_40.md, section 20; tools/share_ask.py). config_cases: the signed config's share_ask (raw, as it came; null when absent) and what the SDK applies (resolved). cases: replay each case's steps in order through the SDK's decision: start from `state` (the stored state; a 3.x state has no installed_at, last_ask_at or last_ask_day, and no app part), apply `set` when a step has one (stored fields that another page or process wrote just before the event: merge them into the stored part, keep the app part), then decide(state, event, config, now) with the case's `config` and the step's `now` ({ms, tz_min}). Each step's `action`, `why` and `state` (the whole new state, its `app` part included) must be what the SDK gets; the next step starts from that state. Times are unix milliseconds; days are whole days in the device's time zone. `rules` names what a case pins.

config_cases.name: every field below its floor: the floor (never shorter than the defaults)
every field above its ceiling: the ceiling
a number with an integral value is that integer
a string, a boolean or null is the default
a pair that is not a list of two: the default pair
a pair that is a string or an object: the default pair
a pair with one bad entry: that entry's default
a pair entry is bounded by its own place: the second re-ask never under 30 days and 10 sessions

cases.name: first ask: not within 24 hours of the install, even after 3 good sessions
first ask: not before the 3rd completed session; exactly 24 hours is soon enough
an interrupted, failed or cancelled take, or one without speech, is not a completed session and never the moment
the 60 s of recitation are this app session's takes: short takes add up, a new app session starts again
an ask in hand is withdrawn when a take starts before it is on screen: nothing counted, decided again at the next end
after Not now: the card needs both 14 days and 7 completed sessions
the second re-ask: 30 days and 10 sessions after the first card
one ask per app session, one per calendar day (each checked before the intervals)
the calendar day is the device's, in its time zone (UTC+3: 23:30 and 00:10 are two days)
the same instants in UTC are one calendar day
three asks in all: the sheet, then two cards dismissed; never a fourth
a config with max_asks 1: no card after Not now
a yes is never asked again
the card opens the full sheet; a yes there: one ask, never asked again
the card opens the full sheet; Not now there: one ask
a card takes no yes: consent is given on the full sheet only; a sheet takes no open
a card on screen goes when a take starts, and when the SDK takes it back: Not now each time
a sheet taken back after it was on screen (an app's own screen): the ask is used, no answer recorded
one ask at a time: while one is in hand or on screen nothing else is asked; a sheet stays when a take starts
another page said yes while this page's card is on screen: this page's answer is ignored
an answer or an event this file does not know changes nothing
sharing turned off ends asking; only the switch turns it on again
off while a card is on screen: the card goes, asking ends
ask(): never at launch, never during a take, then due without the 60 s; the first-ask hours still hold
not offered by the signed config: sessions are counted, nothing is asked
the clock went back: a stored last ask in the future becomes now, and the 14 days count from there
the clock jumped forward a year: the sessions still hold the card back
an install time in the future (the clock was ahead at install) becomes now: the 24 hours count from there
3.x, Not now once: count, answer and sessions kept; the last ask is the upgrade time
3.x, never asked: the install time is the upgrade time (no ask in the first 24 hours after it)
3.x, said yes: never asked
3.x, turned off (or three asks used): never asked
3.x, two asks: the second re-ask waits 30 days from the upgrade and 10 sessions since the last ask
2.0.0 and earlier, five asks shown: never asked
2.0.0, declined without a count: one ask used
3.x, a sheet shown and never answered: the next ask is a card, on the re-ask intervals
another page counted an ask while this one held its own: this one is stale and never shown
an answer without its shown counts the ask then (an SDK that missed it)
a config that tries to shorten everything gets the defaults
a config that lengthens: 48 hours, 5 sessions, 21 and 45 days, 10 and 14 sessions, 120 s
